reason: Analytic preflight of the exact SWBOTB=5 lower-boundary gradient showed that the original multiplicative head probe does not guarantee opposite lower-boundary flow directions for both frozen materials before any ROM-0 trajectory evidence exists.

exact_reference_relation.reversal_condition: hbot > h0 + disnod_bottom gives negative initial head_gradient; hbot < h0 + disnod_bottom gives positive initial head_gradient.

original_probe.issue: For B01 at Se=0.85, h0 is about -29.79 cm. With 10 cm boundary spacing, 0.75*h0 is about -22.35 cm, which remains below the analytic reversal threshold h0+10 about -19.79 cm. The probe therefore cannot guarantee an actual upward/capillary-flow branch for B01.

corrected_probe.direction_reversal: first half uses rise; second half uses fall
rationale: For the homogeneous fixed geometry, node spacing equals dz_cm.
At the uniform initial state, rise gives head_gradient_bottom = -1 and fall gives +3 independent of material h0.
The correction is geometry-scaled rather than material-head-scaled and is therefore a cleaner cross-material direction probe.
